$comment: Dependency policy (ledger ENG-095). The delivered website has NO dependencies of any kind: it is HTML, CSS, three small scripts, fonts, images and video. Everything in package.json is a development tool for building, testing and verifying, never delivered. The policy: no runtime dependencies; every development dependency pinned to an exact version; a committed lockfile with registry sources and sha512 integrity for every package; licences from an allow-list; no known critical vulnerability anywhere, no high vulnerability in a package the verification itself runs, and every other high vulnerability recorded below with a reason. `npm ci --ignore-scripts` installs exactly the lockfile.

licenseNotes.MPL-2.0: axe-core and @axe-core/playwright: file-level copyleft that applies only if modified files are distributed. They are development tools and are never delivered.
licenseNotes.recordedIn: G6-1 removed @lhci/cli and with it parse-cache-control, the only package whose licence the lockfile did not record. Every package in the lockfile now records a licence, and licenseExceptions is empty. Any future exception must name the package, say why and carry a status.

acceptedAdvisories.$comment: Empty since G6-1 (Gate 6, APR-JE-038): the 17 advisories (11 high, 4 moderate, 2 low) were all inside the development-only tree of @lhci/cli (Lighthouse CI), which was replaced by the direct lighthouse package; npm audit reports 0 vulnerabilities for the installed tree. The mechanism stays: any advisory must be reviewed here with a reason, or check:deps fails.

actions.$comment: The GitHub Actions the workflow may use, each pinned to a full commit SHA and verified at the source on the date given (Gate 6, G6-1, APR-JE-038): the tag resolves to the SHA with git ls-remote, the commit is an ancestor of the default branch, and action.yml at that commit declares `runs.using: node24`. check:ci refuses any other action and any other SHA; a change here is a deliberate, reviewed change, never an automatic one.

actions/setup-node.note: v7.1.0 (949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1) also exists; v7.0.0 was chosen because it has been public for three months and v7.1.0 for days. Moving to a newer release is a separate reviewed change.

retiredPackages.reason: Lighthouse CI carried 17 advisories (11 high) in a tree of 221 packages that the verification never ran. It was replaced by the direct lighthouse package and engineering/tools/lighthouse.mjs. Bringing it back needs a reviewed change to this record.
